| [Node-RED flow troubleshooting](SKILL.md) | Agent Skill | Diagnose an OESL Node-RED flow that is broken, silent, or producing wrong values — starting from its exported flow JSON. Runs a static analyser over the export to find the failure modes that actually occur in this estate (unpacked or unre-packed sysTime, protobuf oneof violations, hardcoded secrets or thresholds, a severed pipeline, UUIDs buried in function bodies, missing error handling, unset flow context), then works a symptom-to-cause table for anything the analyser cannot see. Use when a flow publishes nothing, publishes the wrong value or a nonsense timestamp, stops after a redeploy, when a dashboard has gone flat, or when reviewing a flow before it goes to a prod instance. |
